flicker.repeatCriterion: Fail a frame when >0.001 of pixels differ in any RGB channel by >2 after seeking elsewhere and back.
flicker.blinkEncoding: Each [y,x,count] span names count adjacent 8x8 blocks, starting at screenshot-local (x,y), stepping x by 8. Add clip.x/clip.y for page coordinates.

limitations: GPU allocations are arithmetic estimates from measured texture/buffer sizes, not resident memory or process working set; driver/compositor overhead is excluded.
Blink scan uses a non-overlapping 8x8 grid. Every neighbour pixel must match within 3 per RGB channel; the middle block mean absolute difference must exceed 24 in a channel.
Contact frames are half size, then fitted to the 1600-pixel sheet cap when necessary. Scan comparisons retain full stage resolution.
